newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti to divest PC unit by year-end.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti to divest PC unit by year-end.

text.p: Troubled Italian information and technology group Olivetti will divest its personal computer division and other units by the end of this year in a move expected to raise 800 billion lire ($526.3 million), CEO Roberto Colaninno told industry analysts Thursday.
Colaninno said that as well as the PC division, Olivetti aimed to sell off the Tecnost automated systems and software group and its DSI and Venture Capital USA units.
His meeting with the financial analysts was the first since he was appointed chief executive last month.
